content: वल्मीकः, -कम् [वल्-ईक मुट् च <ls>Uṇ. 4. 25</ls>] An ant-hill, a hillock thrown up by white ants, moles <ab>&c.</ab>; धर्मं शनैः संचिनुयादूल्मीकमिव पुत्तिकाः <ls>Subhāṣ.</ls>; <ls>Me. 15</ls>; <ls>Ś. 7. 11</ls>. .{@-कः@} .²1 Swelling of certain parts of the body, elephantiasis. .²2 The poet Vālmīki.
